body: The Criminal Mind moved this afternoon, on Ziggy's decisions (in substance): character generation is held until the casting call is complete; every image attached to the board until then is set-only, no people and no hands, so the space is known before anyone inhabits it; the shot audit's corrections are placed now (the delta, attached: 24 placeholder swaps, 8 under-splits adding 12 sub-shots, 33 inserts, 92 roster trims, 202 card-text corrections for CFA Nova's return, 8 set gaps) and the cover cards are re-cut again at casting; a camera map per set, read from each shot's Camera and Lighting fields, is the set round (attached: twenty families plus four new gap families, every position naming the shots it serves, under the Chief of Staff's cap of 300). Baldadoon chose TCM-SET-HENDERSON-EXTERIOR-L03 as the house; the interiors follow it. Batch TCM-01 as posted this afternoon is withdrawn. For the site: when the set round returns, each image binds to the shots its position serves (a design_reference row in 11.2; the shot's Camera and Lighting fields point at the position; 11.9's set gap clears for those shots); Ziggy's reading is that the set work lands in field 2 Camera per shot, with the kitchen roll-up downstream and not yet settled. The project's decisions record is opened (attached). No author question is added; Baldadoon's A to O stand.
